19-sorry: Apologizing sheepishly: one white-gloved hand rubbing the back of its head under the cap, the other hand raised in front with palm out in an apologetic gesture, body bowed slightly forward, eyes squeezed shut, awkward embarrassed grin, one big bright blue sweat drop beside its head.
20-love: Hugging a big puffy cartoon heart to its chest with both arms, eyes closed blissfully, huge happy smile, three small hearts floating above its head. Exception to the palette: the hearts are bright red with bold black outlines.
21-laughing: Laughing out loud: leaning back with one hand holding its belly and the other hand slapping the air, eyes squeezed shut, mouth wide open in a huge belly laugh, small bright blue tear drops of joy flying from its eyes, one sneaker kicked up off the ground.
22-good-night: Sleeping peacefully: lying curled up on its side on a fluffy white pillow, hugging a corner of the pillow, eyes closed, calm little smile, cap still on and slightly tilted, a small yellow crescent moon and two little stars floating above it. Wide horizontal composition.
